feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 September 2026 7:33am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 16 September 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

A transient ridge of high pressure will decline as a deep area of low pressure in the Atlantic drives frontal systems across the area later today and tonight.


##Wind##

West or northwest 4 or 5, gradually backing southwest, then increasing 5 or 6 late evening, occasionally 7 early tonight, then veering west 5 or 6 later in the night.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon decreasing slight, then increasing moderate late evening. Perhaps occasionally rough in the east of the area for a time overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain arriving from the west through the evening and overnight. Clearing later in the night.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.
